description: This file provides a comprehensive subtitle correction pipeline for a media platform. It handles normalization, grammar and style corrections, OTT compliance (like line length and formatting), and optional audio-based corrections using ASR. It leverages multiple optional dependencies for NLP, fuzzy matching, and speech recognition, and contains utilities for transcript normalization and text harmonization.
